doc_summary:
[a block's items](#a-blocks-items) for server mods, what a pipe or a machine needs to pull from other blocks: `native_container_slots`, `native_extract_item`
and `native_move_items`, and `native_dimension` for a machine's tick to name its level. `native_insert_item` now goes one item at a time, so it no longer overfills a slot,
leaves a client's copy of the world alone, and can't reach a machine's own slots during its tick, where what went in was lost. Bundles that use the new helpers need `"hooks": @API:block_items@`.
